title: Joyaro - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Joyaro in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Joyaro is a lightning-element weapon used by Monoco. It scales with Defense (A), Agility (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Joyaro
sections.content:
Location: Flying Manor - enemy drop.

Obtained from Flying Manor - enemy drop.

sections.title: Is the Joyaro Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (A), Agility (B). A dedicated lightning pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
